eventId.description: Unique identifier for this specific event occurrence

type.description: Name of the event type, e.g., PaymentSucceeded, PaymentFailed

version.description: Schema version of the event payload

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the domain event occurred

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the primary aggregate (e.g. bookingId) used as Kafka partition key

traceId.description: W3C trace context or OpenTelemetry trace ID for distributed tracing
